carddav_url_template.label: CardDAV URL template
carddav_url_template.desc: Addressbook URL for this server, e.g. https://dav.example.com/dav/addressbooks/user/{user}/Default - {user} = mailbox name as the DAV server knows it, {email} = full address, {login} = local part, {domain} = domain part. Leave empty to disable.

dav_default_domain.label: DAV default domain
dav_default_domain.desc: Addresses in this domain are addressed by local part only, everything else by full address. On Cyrus with "virtdomains: userid" this is imapd.conf defaultdomain. Leave empty to always use the full address.
